definitions.definition: 本法所稱人工智慧，指具自主運行能力之系統，該系統透過輸入或感測，經由機器學習及演算法，可為明確或隱含之目標實現預測、內容、建議或決策等影響實體或虛擬環境之產出。
definitions.english: Artificial intelligence, as referred to in this Act, means a system with the capability of autonomous operation which, through input or sensing and by means of machine learning and algorithms, can produce, for explicit or implicit objectives, outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions that influence physical or virtual environments.

note: Quoted from the National Science and Technology Council's law database page of the Artificial Intelligence Basic Act (official.html; promulgated 民國 115 年 01 月 14 日, i.e. 14 January 2026, by order 華總一義字第11500001671號). The Act defines 'artificial intelligence' (人工智慧) itself as a system, so the item is in the 'artificial intelligence' group; it has no separate definition of 'AI system'. Article 17 refers to high-risk AI applications (高風險人工智慧之應用) and Article 5 to AI products or systems that the competent authority, in consultation with the Ministry of Digital Affairs, determines to be high-risk applications; neither is a definition of a high-risk AI system. The stored English page (secondary.html) lists only the English title, 'Artificial Intelligence Basic Act', without the text, so the English rendering is the agent's. document-1.pdf is the database's user manual.
